# References: site sources

<!-- Generated by docs/make_references.py from app/assets/data/sites.json and
app/assets/data/curated_sites.json. Do not edit by hand; run
python3 -I docs/make_references.py. pipeline/tests/test_references.py checks it. -->

This page lists every web source behind the preset sites, with the sites it supports, and
the named features the app refers to. The NASA data (SPICE kernels, LOLA elevation models,
JPL Horizons), the software and the fonts are cited in
[submission.md](submission.md#references), in the
[README](../README.md#data-sources-and-credits) and in
[THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

- **Coordinates:** a source for the site's position or region. It is in
  `app/assets/data/sites.json`, with a note of what the source says.
- **Description:** a source for the site's description in the app. It is in
  `app/assets/data/curated_sites.json`.

There are 98 distinct URLs: 33 for coordinates and 69 for descriptions (13 are both), and 11 for
named features (2 of them also cited for a site). Sources are grouped by the site group they
support, with the most-used first. A source with no recorded title is shown by its URL.

## IAU-named features

To say where a site or a custom spot lies, the app names the nearest of these features
when one is close enough, with its size. Each link is the feature's entry in the
Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature (IAU and USGS).

- **Cabeus** (crater): <https://planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov/Feature/953>
- **de Gerlache** (crater): <https://planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov/Feature/1439>
- **Faustini** (crater): <https://planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov/Feature/1919>
- **Haworth** (crater): <https://planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov/Feature/14502>
- **Malapert** (crater): <https://planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov/Feature/3603>
- **Mons Malapert** (mountain): <https://planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov/Feature/16338>
- **Mons Mouton** (mountain): <https://planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov/Feature/16070>
- **Nobile** (crater): <https://planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov/Feature/4321>
- **Shackleton** (crater): <https://planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov/Feature/5450>
- **Shoemaker** (crater): <https://planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov/Feature/5494>
- **Slater** (crater): <https://planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov/Feature/15325>
